text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Angolan president Jose Eduardo dos Santos is in Madrid, Spain, at the invitation of King Juan Carlos.
- The government said it wanted guarantee of security before it proceeded with the relocation of about three million war displaced people in the country.

- Leader of the opposition Partido de Renovacao Social, Eduardo Cuangana, said the government and UNITA were at an impasse in implementing the Lusaka peace pact because of a lack of political will to overcome their differences.
